authority: User collected requirements and said DONE; implementation in Default mode
supersedes: Original handwritten/system component fonts: user now requires Comfortaa throughout
Full 3D course flip: user chose fade with short directional slide
Olympiad presentation exemption: user now requires shared styling and completion gems, without curriculum mastery

requirements.buttons: Curriculum question-end row right aligned, one row, exactly Check, Clear, Give Up, Next. Use shared action implementation across source/generic/dotcross players. Small screens keep one row with compact accessible geometry; no horizontal page overflow.
requirements.check: Check initial required response through existing marking; thereafter Check corrections without fresh evidence. Next disabled until accepted first assessment (wrong or correct) or Give Up. Invalid/incomplete submission does not unlock Next. Retain legitimate staged rubric review before final assessment.
requirements.clear: Clear current editable response/editor state to original blank/initial state, invalidate stale current correction feedback/highlight; preserve attempt ID, assistance, frozen first response/score/timing, and already-earned Next access. Never reset progress or create evidence.
requirements.giveUp: Give Up reveals model answer, using existing assistance/reveal semantics; no independent mastery credit for unassessed give-up. Next becomes enabled/highlighted. A post-assessment give-up preserves first result. Disallow accidental repeated evidence.
requirements.keyboard: Check highlighted/default until current correct result or Give Up; then Next highlighted/default. Editing/clearing after correctness invalidates current correctness and returns default to Check. Typed questions autofocus first enabled answer input on new question only. Enter advances required typed inputs in order, then Check; if Next is current default Enter advances. Shift+Enter preserves multiline newline. Avoid duplicate native form/click activation, IME submission or hijacking focused controls/diagram shortcuts.
requirements.electron: Remove Set spins without cycling section from EC; retain normal cycling and standard keyboard accessibility.
requirements.width: One shared default question-pane max width matching existing ordinary questions. Remove dotcross full-width exception. Responsive diagrams fit internal viewport without clipping or page overflow.
requirements.background: Use exact landing-page background as one shared application background including all questions, stats, teacher/import and Olympiad. Preserve readable card surfaces.
requirements.font: Enforce Comfortaa for all app text and controls, feedback, code badges, typed responses and live diagram labels. Eliminate local handwriting/system/serif overrides. Preserve scientific notation and existing validated path-based molecular depictions; do not regenerate approved scientific assets just to restyle HTML.
requirements.transition: Replace whole-course 650ms rotateY flip with opacity plus approximately16px horizontal slide, total about220ms, direction following IGCSE/A Level toggle. No 3D rotation. Reduced motion immediate. Preserve preference, routing, focus, single active course and rapid-toggle safeguards; keep existing L6/U6 transition.
requirements.olympiad: Landing matches A Level brand/background/width/gem-card styling. One gem per registered challenge with accessible title/status; unstarted dim, partially validated completion partly lit, fully validated completion fully lit. Derive live/reloaded status from existing challenge progress/policies, never curriculum mastery/stats. Existing challenges adopt shared question frame/font/background. User explicitly chose to retain Olympiad staged controls and restyle them; do not impose the four curriculum buttons or alter challenge progression. No chemistry/content changes.
